message.content:
This editorial magazine cover features the red title "TEMPO" against a black background. Above the title, text reads "NENENG DITANGKAP, SUAP TERUNGKAP?", "Om Liem 1916-2012", and "KONGKALIKONG PAJAK BHAKTI INVESTAMA". Below the title, smaller white text states "EDISI 18-24 JUNI 2012". 

The central illustration is a circular green radar display with concentric rings, a grid of dotted lines, and a light-green map outline. Numerous small white airplane icons are scattered across the screen, some with accompanying green alphanumeric text. One larger, detailed airplane icon in white, red, and blue is highlighted with a red circular glow near the center. The lower right features large yellow text: "MUSABAB JATUHNYA SUKHOI". 

In the bottom left corner, a price of "RP 29.700" is shown alongside a website address, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0124-4273". A white barcode block with several numbers sits at the bottom edge. The overall design is framed by a thin red border on the left and bottom.
